layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records
Add integration test for denied exports
Document CSV export in usage guide

notes: Shared base for the export cycle at SYNCHRONIZING, built on export-project. Twelve post-install commits in the brownfield order. 20-context: Auditor CONTEXT.md (same text as export-documenting) and STATE starting cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 as STANDARD, FORWARD AUDITING to SCOPING. 22-scope: scope with three current ACs (AC-001 filtered CSV export with RFC 4180 quoting; AC-002 non-admin or anonymous export rejected by server-side authorization before any export file is written; AC-003 accurate usage guide in docs/usage.md); STATE ARCHITECTING. 24-design: same contract as export-testing; AC-001 and AC-002 technical coverage and criteria, AC-003 No architectural impact (Documenter); STATE DEVELOPING. 26-plan: APPROVED plan, three PENDING steps (DEV-003 maps AC-001 and AC-002), AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION / NONE, Plan Notes assign AC-003 to Documenter; STATE records Development. 28-export: implementation and tests byte-identical to export-testing/export-documenting 40-export. 30-complete: plan COMPLETE with self-check evidence; STATE TESTING. 32-access-test: integration test byte-identical to export-reviewing-impl 46-access-test. 34-verification: COMPLETE FULL verification (AC-001 three criteria and AC-002 Verified, AC-003 pending later-role dependency on Documenter); STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 36-review: COMPLETE IMPLEMENTATION review, no material findings, AC-003 permitted dependency; STATE DOCUMENTING. 38-guide: Documenter's guide change (export section, roles bullet in docs/usage.md; README link text, test:integration command, layout entries) as its own commit so later records can cite it by COMMIT and BLOB. 40-documentation: COMPLETE documentation record (Documenter template, AUTONOMOUS, ACTIVE_CHANGE, User Style NONE, no DOC entries); STATE REVIEWING_FINAL. 42-final-review: COMPLETE FINAL_DELIVERABLE review with no findings, resolving the AC-003 dependency; STATE SYNCHRONIZING with FORWARD from REVIEWING_FINAL. Records cite revisions with COMMIT placeholders and contents with BLOB placeholders; every cited identity matches the final tree. No synchronization record; tree clean.
baseFacts: Everything export-project states about the project outside the export feature and outside docs/usage.md and README.md remains true: src/records (store, parseFilter), src/auth (roles, authorize, requireAdmin), src/http (HttpError, messages, Router), GET /records for every signed-in role, the six seed records (record 1 title has a comma, record 3 title has double quotes), and the pnpm workspace with @records/seed.

Cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 is active: ProjectMode BROWNFIELD, CycleMode STANDARD, WorkflowState SYNCHRONIZING, PendingCycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleRequest UNSET, PendingCycleBlockedOn NONE. Active Work: Request `Let administrators export the filtered records list as CSV; non-admins must not be able to export. Document the export in the usage guide.`; Scope, Architecture, Development at vars SCOPE, ARCH, DEV; PromotionReason, AuditTarget, BlockedOn, PendingVerificationCadence, and BaselineReconciliation NONE. Handoff: Kind FORWARD, From REVIEWING_FINAL, FailureType NONE, Reason `Final-deliverable review passed with no open findings.` Recovery and Outstanding Obligations are inactive (Active false, no frames, no obligations).

.standards/CONTEXT.md is the Auditor context committed first in the cycle (same text as export-documenting): baseline before the export, stack, structure, the command pnpm --filter export test, the convention that handlers call authorize first, seed data notes, the testing baseline, and evidence citing the commit 'Document listing and filtering records'. It predates the implementation and has no provenance block.

The scope record (vars SCOPE, SCOPE provenance) defines exactly three current conditions and no retired ones: AC-001 administrators can export the currently filtered records as CSV with RFC 4180 quoting of fields containing a comma, double quote, or newline (embedded quotes doubled); AC-002 an export request from a non-administrator or no signed-in user is rejected by server-side authorization before any export file is written; AC-003 the usage guide docs/usage.md accurately describes how administrators export records as CSV, including who may export, the filters an export accepts, what it returns and writes, and its error responses.

The technical design (vars ARCH, ARCHITECTURE provenance) specifies POST /records/export with the GET /records filters via parseFilter; requireAdmin first (401 authentication required, 403 forbidden); 400 for invalid status with no file; 201 with content-type text/csv; charset=utf-8, content-disposition attachment naming the file, body equal to the file; header id,title,owner,status,createdAt, rows in ascending id, CRLF after every row, RFC 4180 quoting for comma, double quote, CR, LF; file <exportDir>/records-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.csv in UTC, exportDir default exports, created when missing, gitignored. Acceptance Coverage: AC-001 and AC-002 technical, AC-003 No architectural impact. Technical Acceptance Criteria: two for AC-001, one for AC-002. Same-second overwrite and never-removed export files are accepted risks.

The development plan (vars DEV) has Mode AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE, User Style Locked true, Status COMPLETE, Verification Cadence AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, no Verification Increments section. DEV-001 CSV serialization (AC-001), DEV-002 export file naming and writing (depends on DEV-001, AC-001), DEV-003 administrator-only export route (depends on DEV-002, AC-001 and AC-002), all DONE with self-checks citing the commit 'Add CSV export of filtered records'. Plan Notes say no Developer step covers AC-003 (Documenter's guide).

Implementation files (src/, packages/, package.json, .gitignore, pnpm-lock.yaml) are byte-identical to the commit 'Add CSV export of filtered records' and to the export-testing, export-reviewing-impl, and export-documenting bases: csvCell, toCsv, exportFileName, writeExport in src/export.ts; POST /records/export in src/routes/export.ts calling requireAdmin(request.user) first, then store.list(parseFilter(request.query)), writeExport, and a 201 text/csv response; createApp options records, exportDir (default exports), now. The implementation satisfies AC-001 and AC-002 and has no material defects.

test/export.test.ts has the five serialization tests; test/integration/export-flow.test.ts is byte-identical to export-reviewing-impl (two admin export tests plus 'export requests without an administrator are denied and write no file'). package.json scripts: test = node --test test/*.test.ts, test:integration = node --test test/integration/export-flow.test.ts. pnpm --filter export test passes 21 tests; pnpm --filter export test:integration passes 3. No exports directory exists.

docs/usage.md (changed only by the commit 'Document CSV export in usage guide') keeps the roles, listing, filtering, and errors sections of export-project, adds the bullet 'Only `admin` can export records.' under Roles, and adds a section '## Exporting records as CSV' with subsections '### CSV format' and '### Limits'. It accurately describes POST /records/export: same filters and validation as GET /records, admin only with the role check first, 401 authentication required, 403 forbidden, 400 for an invalid status with no file, 405 for GET /records/export, 201 with content-type and content-disposition headers and the CSV body, the file exports/records-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.csv (UTC, folder created when missing, relative to the working directory, exportDir option, gitignored), the header row, CRLF rows, RFC 4180 quoting with an owner=dana example equal to the integration test's expected file, the same-second overwrite, and that files are not removed.

README.md (changed by the same commit) links docs/usage.md for listing, filtering, and exporting, lists both test commands, and its layout names src/export.ts, both route handlers, test/integration/, and exports/. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md contain only the installer's managed blocks.

The verification record (vars VERIFICATION) has Mode VERIFY, Status COMPLETE, User Style NONE, Assessment Purpose FULL, Assessment Target NONE, cites the commit 'Add integration test for denied exports' and BLOB identities of scope, design, context, plan, src/export.ts, src/routes/export.ts, src/app.ts, and both test files. Acceptance Evidence: three AC-001 rows and one AC-002 row Verified via E1 (21 passed), E2 (3 passed), inspection I1; an AC-003 row pending later role Documenter. Open Findings and Dependencies lists only that dependency. No AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION, no Increment Assessments.

The implementation review (vars REVIEW_IMPL, ReviewKind IMPLEMENTATION) has Status COMPLETE, User Style NONE, cites the commit 'Record CSV export verification' as assessed revision and 'Document listing and filtering records' as baseline, accounts for AC-001 (three criteria) and AC-002 as Supported and AC-003 as a permitted dependency on Documenter, records R1 (21 passed), R2 (3 passed), inspection R3, and No material findings.

The documentation record (vars DOC, DOCUMENTATION provenance) has Status COMPLETE, Collaboration AUTONOMOUS, Target ACTIVE_CHANGE, User Style NONE; it cites the commit 'Document CSV export in usage guide' and the BLOBs of docs/usage.md and README.md (equal to HEAD), plus the contract, records, and implementation identities; it accounts for AC-001, AC-002, AC-003; records checks G1 (statement-by-statement inspection), G2 (integration run, 3 passed), G3 (one-off script: 405, 400 with no folder, owner=dana export equal to the guide example), G4 (structure inspection); discrepancies NONE; conclusion: target and full Documenter gate complete.

The final-deliverable review (vars REVIEW_FINAL, ReviewKind FINAL_DELIVERABLE) has Status COMPLETE, User Style NONE, cites the commit 'Record CSV export documentation' as assessed revision and BLOBs of every contract record, supporting record, implementation, test, and documentation file (all equal to HEAD); accounts for AC-001, AC-002, AC-003 as Supported, records the AC-003 dependency as resolved, checks C1 (21 passed), C2 (3 passed), C3 to C5 inspections; No material findings; no later dependencies.
There is no synchronization record; .standards/docs/synchronization does not exist. No .standards/user-styles directory exists. No record contains F-NNN, D-NNN, or DOC-NNN entries.
No file under src/, test/, packages/, docs/, or README.md contains an AC identifier.

Commit subjects after the installer commit, oldest first: 'Record project context for CSV export', 'Define CSV export scope', 'Design CSV export', 'Plan CSV export implementation', 'Add CSV export of filtered records', 'Mark CSV export plan complete', 'Add integration test for denied exports', 'Record CSV export verification', 'Record CSV export implementation review', 'Document CSV export in usage guide', 'Record CSV export documentation', 'Record CSV export final review'.
The working tree is clean (git diff empty, nothing untracked), and node .standards/bin/check.mjs passes.

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `guide-`)), `out`); const app = createApp({ exportDir: dir, now: () => new Date(`2026-09-24T09:00:00Z`) }); const admin = { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` }; const send = (user, query, method) => app.handle({ method: method || `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: query || {}, user }); const codes = [send(null).status, send({ id: 3, name: `Vik`, role: `viewer` }).status, send({ id: 2, name: `Eli`, role: `editor` }).status, send(admin, { status: `deleted` }).status, send(admin, {}, `GET`).status]; if (codes.join() !== `401,403,403,400,405` || fs.existsSync(dir)) { console.error(codes); process.exit(1); } const q = String.fromCharCode(34); const crlf = String.fromCharCode(13, 10); const expected = [`id,title,owner,status,createdAt`, `1,` + q + `Lease agreement, Building B` + q + `,dana,active,2026-03-02T10:15:00Z`, `3,` + q + `Q2 ` + q + q + `priority` + q + q + ` accounts review` + q + `,dana,archived,2026-04-01T08:05:00Z`, ``].join(crlf); const ok = send(admin, { owner: `dana` }); const file = path.join(dir, `records-20260924T090000Z.csv`); if (ok.status !== 201 || ok.headers[`content-type`] !== `text/csv; charset=utf-8` || !ok.headers[`content-disposition`].includes(`records-20260924T090000Z.csv`) || ok.body !== expected || fs.readFileSync(file, `utf8`) !== expected) { console.error(ok); process.exit(2); } console.log(`documented export behavior holds`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: the behavior the guide documents holds: 401, 403, 403, 400 and 405 with no folder created, and the owner=dana export equals the guide's CSV example in both body and file
the SYNCHRONIZING state and records are valid
